rules.rule: When creating any new file in specs/, tests/, or elsewhere in the project, use hyphens as word separators in the filename.
Do not commit changes after completing a task unless the user explicitly asks you to commit.
Never commit directly to the main branch; every change must be made on its own dedicated branch.
Do not push to GitHub unless the user explicitly says "sync" or an equivalent request.
Commit code freely without asking for permission.
Never run `git push` unless the user asks to sync.
Before running any git add or git commit, confirm the current working branch is not main.
Ensure all C++ code passes clang-tidy before committing it.
If the current working branch is main, create a new branch before making any commit.
Do not edit the llvm-project/ source per-branch in a worktree.
Merge changes into main only when the user explicitly says to.
Before re-running an audit on a shallow clone, unshallow it with `git fetch --unshallow <source> <branch>`.
Ask the user for approval before downloading and launching a real VS Code instance for a probe.
Before pushing a change to `.github/workflows/*.yml`, scan the committed bytes for C0 control characters (below 0x20, excluding tab, LF, CR), not just parse the YAML.
Before opening a PR, run `git ls-remote --heads origin` and confirm the base branch exists.
Check a gate's exit code explicitly before any commit or push in the same command chain.
Run the mailmap pass as the last step before the final push, not earlier.
Scope the rename config-object scan to a single project so it does not rewrite other projects' `.TcVIS`/`.TcTLO`/`.TcTTO` files.
While a delegated agent is working in a checkout, do not switch branches in that checkout.
While a delegated agent is working in a checkout, do not edit files the agent is likely to rewrite (such as HANDOFF.md, ROADMAP.md, or docs).
Make your own edits only in files the delegated agent was told not to touch.
After delegating, run post-merge syncs as `git fetch` only, with no checkout, until the agent reports done.
Use a GitHub PR workflow with Codex automated review before merging changes.
Before submitting a PR, run end-to-end tests covering all major paths, not just one path.
Before submitting a PR, list all trigger paths and verify each one individually.
Never touch data/, backups/, reports.db, secret.key, or .env.
Never run go test or go vet with the ./... pattern.
Run the verify skill before committing a finished feature.
Do not change a problem package's solver, evaluator, or instance data without maintainer approval.
When working in a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/<slug>`, make file edits with `Edit`/`Write` using absolute paths under the main project root, not the worktree path.
When working in a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/<slug>`, run the project's build tools and `git` commands against the main project path, not the worktree path.
Using a whole-file Write is permitted when creating brand-new files.
When working in a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/<slug>`, never switch branches in the worktree to commit there.
Do not try to fix drift by editing the pre-commit hook.
Make portable pre-commit hook fixes in `dev-manifest.json` in dev-tools.
Do not edit `~/dev/templates/` directly to fix the pre-commit hook.
Store memory files in `.claude/memory/` within the project repo, not in `~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/`.
Write any new memory files to the project repo, never to the legacy userdir location.

Do not extend the legacy canvas and chat code (`Jarble-mvp/components/canvas/`, `useCanvasChat.ts`, `AssistantUIChat.tsx`, `SimpleCanvasGrid.tsx`, `lib/assistantRuntime.ts`, `render_ui` / `define_component` tools in `jarble-ui-server.js`).
Do not invoke the `canvas-component-builder` agent or the `/new-component` skill.
When updating the modpack, wipe the itzg install marker before restarting.
Do not implement phase 3 (useReducer for Group A state) unless profiling shows a need for it.
Fix the critical audit issues C1-C4 (listed in AUDIT-REPORT.md) before deploying to production.
Fix the high-priority audit issues H1-H11 (listed in AUDIT-REPORT.md) before releasing a public beta.
Do not fast-forward main to merge-branch until the user has approved the merge.
Never force-push.
Never edit the main branch directly.
Never run DB DROP statements.
Never force-delete deployments.
In the next session, focus on action-oriented testing first, then merge the branch to main.
